voice_notes: Wickerbottom is a stern, precise librarian: clipped clinical labels ("Ectoplasmic residue.", "Transdimensional weaponry."), Latin binomials, dry book puns ("It's gripping, frankly.", "I've given it a glowing review."), a condescending "dear", and open distaste for shadow magic ("I do not care for this type of magic."); she always calls nightmare fuel "ectoplasmic residue" and prizes silence ("Shhhh! No talking!"). PT-BR renders her formally and literally precise, "meu bem" for dear, and the vanilla Codex line as "ISSO não entra na MINHA biblioteca de jeito nenhum!", which the new codex line echoes with "MINHA biblioteca ... não entra". ZH keeps her formal and bookish (灵质残渣 for the fuel, 亲爱的, 啧啧) with the caps emphasis dropped, as in 我不会让那个出现在我的图书馆！. RU uses feminine forms, "дорогуша"/"Божечки", «Кодекс», no ё, and keeps the caps ("Я не позволю ЭТОМУ быть в МОЕЙ библиотеке!"), which the RU codex line mirrors with "МОЕЙ библиотеки ему не место". Fuel is always "resíduo ectoplásmico" / 灵质残渣 / "остатки эктоплазмы", following her official NIGHTMAREFUEL line in each language.

line_notes.codex: She can use the book now, but files it as a reference-only volume, library jargon that still keeps her vanilla 'not in MY library' disdain.
line_notes.codex_needsfuel: As a writer of her own books she treats the empty Codex as a pen out of ink, and she uses her own term for nightmare fuel.
line_notes.no_max_sanity: Precise, clinical self-assessment ('mental faculties', 'at capacity') makes the failure clear without any melodrama.
line_notes.shadow_mine: A self-publishing librarian describes her copy in publishing terms, and her 'Shhhh! No talking!' ideal survives in the one thing she approves of.
line_notes.shadow_other: The cataloguer's instinct: an unidentified copy should carry an owner's label, much like her praise for 'Color-coded and clearly labeled.'
